## Markup

```html
<!-- Search input plus toggleable chips; pressed state is the applied filter. -->
<form class="uifa-filter-bar" role="search" aria-label="Filter">
  <input data-uifa-slot="search" type="search" name="q" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search">
  <div data-uifa-slot="chips">
    <button type="button" data-uifa-slot="chip" aria-pressed="false">Filter</button>
  </div>
</form>
```

## Usage

Compose a search input and filter chips in one row. Chips are `type="button"` with `aria-pressed` carrying the applied state; CSS renders pressed chips solid. Give a chip `data-uifa-variant="warn"` for caution filters such as overdue.
